findings.claim: DeepSWE v1.1 public board (updated 2026-09-03) still has no Claude Fable 5.1 row. Closest Claude row is claude-fable-5 [xhigh] 70%±3% /$13.41 — wrong model for the concrete. Astra↔Flash pass@1 overlaps within CI; costs do NOT converge within noise (~2.8×).
findings.notes: Re-confirmed live HTML. Path-1 requires Fable 5.1 jointly; Fable 5 cannot substitute. Cost divergence also fails the 'within noise' retire clause even for the two-lane subset.

findings.claim: AA Coding Agent Index v1.5 comparison tables: Devin Fusion CLI same-harness runs Claude Fable 5.1 XHigh+SWE-2 ($7.90/task, Index 62) AND GPT-6 Astra XHigh+SWE-2 ($4.54/task, Index 59). Gemini 3.8 Flash (high) appears only under Antigravity SDK ($2.47/task, Index 42) — different harness. Closest new Fable-5.1+Astra same-harness cost panel found this hunt; Flash still not on that harness.
findings.notes: Partial toward path 1 (2/3 models, correct Fable 5.1). Costs diverge ~1.7× Fable vs Astra on Devin; Flash cost is cross-harness and cannot retire a leg within noise.

findings.claim: AA (2026-09-09): On Coding Agent Index, Astra in Codex ties Fable 5.1 in Claude Code at Index 62; Astra max ~$7.09/task vs Fable ~40% more expensive on that Index cost frontier. Intelligence Index: Astra max and Fable 5.1 max both 53 at $3.26 vs $7.63/task. Gemini 3.8 Flash not in the Coding Agent Index head-to-head pair; on Intelligence Index Flash (high) is ~41 / ~$1.24 — capability not within noise of the 53-pair.
findings.notes: Native-harness pairs (Codex vs Claude Code), not one shared harness; Flash missing from the Coding Agent tie. Intelligence Index cost panel has all three models but is not an agentic same-harness coding panel and does not show cost OR capability convergence across all three.

findings.claim: Real-SWE lists all three lanes with cost-per-resolved-task (~$17.94 Fable 5.1/Claude Code, ~$13.82 Astra/Codex CLI, ~$8.01 Flash/Gemini CLI) but authors state native-harness pairing explicitly — NOT same-harness. Already logged in Job B hunt; still fails path-1 same-harness gate.
